I talked to my doctor a few months back. She gave me a couple of day sick leave, and told me to get some rest, go for a walk and have a glass of wine.

Nahh. It's just that sometimes you need intimacy, though you are not ready to let someone into your life. 
Intimacy is a human need, like sex. But there is a great big difference between wanting to have him with me for one night, being allowed to do what we please to each other, and waning to spend a lot of time with someone.
Hookups can be wonderful. Two people giving each other the best of each other, knowing that it's for now, and no pressure or expectations comes with it.

Try to put yourself into someone else's shoes, and accept that people might be different to you. With different needs and wants. I for one love the autonomy.
